name: Online marketplace manager
summary: Lists and sells on marketplaces beyond the brand's own store, such as eBay, Walmart and overseas sites. Maps product data to each marketplace's rules.

changelog.note: First release: eBay, Walmart, bol, Zalando and Uber Eats fees and standards, listings and GPSR details, buyer claims and appeals, INFORM Act, EU DSA, DAC7, HMRC and 1099-K reporting, access levels 1 to 3 with bulk price changes and appeals needing a fresh yes, Amazon pointed to its own kit, 29 checked sources.
